notes.title: v2 Update: New Maps, Visual Enhancements & Drift Controls
notes.content:
Extreme Car Drift Simulator v2 update is here! With this major update, the visual quality in the game has increased, the gameplay feeling has been improved and brand new content has been added. Drifting is now freer, more enjoyable and much more dynamic!

v2 Update Notes
[list]
[*] 5 Different New Maps added: With 5 new maps with different atmospheres and difficulty levels, the drifting excitement is now more diverse. You can test your skills in many different environments from the city to the open areas.
[*] Camera System improved: With new camera angles and transition effects, a smoother control and a more cinematic driving experience are now offered.
[*] Graphics quality improved and optimized: Visuals have been re-optimized for more stable FPS on all devices. In addition, lighting and texture details have been made clearer.
[*] UI adjustments have been made: Menu designs and in-game interfaces have been overhauled. A more user-friendly structure is offered.
[*] Bugs fixed according to user feedback: All detected bugs have been fixed and performance has been increased throughout the game.
[/list]
